tips.text: Gather the Duviri materials in a solo Duviri Experience run, not inside Isleweaver; its map rarely passes the fields and caves where they grow.
Complete one decree or earn one Intrinsic point after you finish gathering, then abort; Duviri only banks your loot when progress saves.
Take the Bountiful Harvest decree before plant hunting; it doubles Kovnik, Connla Sprout, Silphsela and Saggen Pearl pickups.
Ride the Kaithe while foraging; it shows nearby resources on the minimap, which helps most for Connla Sprout.
Look at the Duviri loadout the spiral rolled you before launching; take Steel Path only with a good frame and weapon, else run normal.
Start one Circuit stage and back out to reroll a bad Duviri loadout; the rotation holds for a couple of hours.
Wall-latch or use Operator void mode during Oraxia's add phase; the Death Scuttlers disable abilities and the floor is a damage field.
Skip boosters and Retriever mods for husks; Steel Path is the only way to raise the Scuttler Husk payout.
Leave Companions and the Gear wheel out of your plan for Isleweaver; both are disabled there.
Expect AFK squadmates in public Isleweaver runs; they hurt most on Steel Path where the boss is heavily damage-attenuated.
Nobody complains about this farm; the grumbling is about Steel Path tuning, which you can skip.
Expect five or six Isleweaver runs at 15 to 20 minutes each, one focused solo Duviri foraging session, then a day of foundry time.
